theme: 全真模擬考 第 2 回

words.ex: The two courses overlap on Monday mornings.
The new dormitory has a capacity of 800 students.
Interns must keep company data confidential.
This scholarship is restricted to low-income students.
After weeks of negotiation, the clubs agreed.
The argument was supported by strong evidence.
She decided to do a minor in data science.
You need your transcript to apply.
Intermediate courses require a placement test.
The professor arranged a make-up class.
A mentor encouraged the team to keep trying.
Leftover vegetables are turned into compost.

audio.t: When does the add and drop period end this semester?

questions.explain: 問的是「何時」結束，(B) 下週五回答了時間。(A) 重複 drop 這個字但答非所問；(C) 回答的是地點。

audio.t: Who's giving the keynote speech at the engineering symposium?

options: A professor from Kyoto, I heard.
The key is at the front desk.
questions.explain: 問「誰」演講，(A) 回答一位京都來的教授。(B) 用 key 與 keynote 混淆；(C) 回答地點。

audio.t: Could you water my plants while I'm away at the conference?

options: There's a water fountain down the hall.
Sure, just leave me your room key.
questions.explain: 對方請求幫忙澆花，(C) 答應並要鑰匙最合理。(A) 重複 conference 但時態不對；(B) 用 water 混淆，說的是飲水機。

audio.t: Why was the chemistry lab closed this morning?

options: They were repairing a gas leak.
It's next to the physics lab.
questions.explain: Why 問原因，(A) 修理瓦斯外洩是原因。(B) Wh- 問句不能用 Yes 回答；(C) 回答位置。

audio.t: You've already paid your tuition, haven't you?

options: It's a high price to pay.
Not yet. I'm still waiting for my loan.
questions.explain: 附加問句確認是否已繳學費，(C) 還沒，在等貸款，切題。(A) 用 pay 混淆；(B) 用 tutor 與 tuition 音近混淆。

audio.t: How often does the film club meet?

questions.explain: How often 問頻率，(B) 每隔一週的週三。(A) 回答人數（How many）；(C) 回答電影類型，與 film 相關但沒回答頻率。

audio.t: I can't find my name on the exam seating chart.

options: The exam was harder than I expected.
You can sit wherever you like in the cafe.
Did you check the list for the other classroom?
questions.explain: 對方找不到座位表上的名字，(C) 建議看另一間教室的名單最合理。(A) 只重複 exam；(B) 用 sit 與 seating 混淆，場景也不對。

audio.t: Would you rather live on campus or rent an apartment next year?

options: On campus, I think. It's cheaper.
The rent is due on the first.
questions.explain: 二選一問句要選其中之一，(A) 選住校並說明理由。(B) 選擇問句不能只答 Yes；(C) 重複 rent，但說的是繳租日期。

audio.t: What's the best way to get a reference letter from Professor Wu?

options: The reference books are on the second shelf.
Email the professor and attach your resume.
That's the best teacher I've had.
questions.explain: 問取得推薦信的方法，(B) 寄信並附履歷。(A) 用 reference 混淆成參考書；(C) 重複 best，未回答方法。

audio.t: Where can I find the results of the student election?

options: I voted for the other candidate.
questions.explain: Where 問地點，(B) 學生會網站。(A) 說投票時間；(C) 說自己投給誰，都只是與選舉相關，未回答在哪裡看結果。

audio.t: The campus bookstore is having a sale on used textbooks this week.

options: No, the bookstore isn't that far.
Great, I still need one for biology.
questions.explain: 對方告知二手教科書特賣，(C) 表示正好還需要生物課本，回應自然。(A) 用 novel 混淆 book；(B) 回應距離，對方沒有提到。

audio.t: Shouldn't we tell the professor that our teammate has dropped out?

options: Yes, before we divide up the work again.
The professor told a funny story.
Our team won the game last night.
questions.explain: 否定問句徵求意見，(A) 同意並說明要在重新分工前告知。(B) 重複 professor、tell 的過去式 told；(C) 重複 team，但說的是比賽。

audio.t: Hi, I'd like to get a flu shot. Do I need an appointment?
Not this week. We're running a walk-in clinic in the gym lobby until Thursday. Just bring your student ID.
Is it free?
It's free for students on the university health plan. Otherwise, it's ten dollars.

questions.prompt: What is true about the flu shots this week?
options: They are given only at the health center.
Students must book an appointment online.
They are available until the end of the week.
They can be received without an appointment.
questions.explain: 男子說這週不用預約（walk-in clinic），故選 (D)。(A) 地點是體育館大廳；(B) 與「不用預約」相反；(C) 只到週四，不是整週。

audio.t: Attention, residents of Maple Hall. The elevators will be out of service from nine a.m. to three p.m. on Tuesday for annual maintenance. Residents who have mobility problems or need help moving heavy items should call the front desk by Monday evening.

questions.prompt: What should residents with mobility problems do?
options: Move to another hall on Tuesday
Contact the front desk by Monday evening
Use the elevators after nine a.m.
questions.explain: 廣播要行動不便者週一晚上前打電話給櫃台，故選 (B)。(A) 未提到換宿舍；(C) 九點正是開始停用的時間。

audio.t: Did you hear the deadline for the English essay contest was moved?
Really? I thought it was this Friday.
It was, but now it's the Friday after next, because the contest website was down for two days.
Oh, great. That gives me time to ask my tutor to check my draft.

questions.prompt: Why was the deadline changed?
options: The tutors asked for more time.
questions.explain: 男子說因為網站掛了兩天才延期，故選 (A)。(B) 對話沒提投稿人數；(C) 家教只是女子打算利用多出的時間去找的人，不是延期原因。

audio.t: Hello, this is Mei-ling from the career center. You signed up for a mock interview at two o'clock on Thursday, but the interviewer has a schedule conflict. We can offer you either one o'clock on the same day or ten a.m. on Friday. Please reply by noon tomorrow. If we don't hear from you, we'll have to give your slot to someone else.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the message?
options: To confirm the original interview time
To ask the listener to choose a new time
To invite the listener to apply for a job
questions.explain: 訊息提供兩個新時段並請對方回覆，目的是改時間，故選 (C)。(A) 原時間已無法進行；(B) 不是取消，是改期；(D) 模擬面試不是求職邀請。

audio.t: Before we finish, a note about next week's field trip to the wetland park. The bus leaves from the east gate at eight fifteen, not from the main gate as the syllabus says. Wear boots, because the paths are muddy. And you don't need to print the worksheet. I'll hand it out on the bus.

questions.prompt: What information in the syllabus is wrong?
options: The place where the bus leaves
The time of the field trip
questions.explain: 教授更正的是上車地點：東門而非課綱上寫的正門，故選 (A)。(B) 時間沒有被更正；(C)(D) 是額外提醒，不是課綱錯誤。

audio.t: I'm so stressed. I've got two midterms on the same day.
If two exams are at the same time, you can request a make-up. Are yours at the same time?
No, one's in the morning and one's in the afternoon.
Then I don't think the rule applies. Maybe go to your instructors' office hours to review instead.

questions.prompt: Why probably can the woman NOT get a make-up exam?
options: Her exams are at different times.
questions.explain: 補考只適用於考試撞時段，她的考試一早一午，故選 (B)。(A) 未提到申請期限；(C) 老師並未拒絕，男子只是建議去 office hours。

audio.t: Starting next Monday, the second floor cafeteria will no longer provide disposable cups. Customers who bring their own cup will get five dollars off any drink. You can also borrow a reusable cup by scanning your student ID. Borrowed cups must be returned within three days.

questions.prompt: What will customers receive for bringing their own cup?
questions.explain: 自備杯任何飲料折五元，故選 (D)。(A) 未提續杯；(B) 環保杯是用學生證借的，不是獎勵；(C) 三天是歸還期限，不是免費飲料。

audio.t: Excuse me, I think I left my umbrella in this classroom during the last period.
Everything that's found here gets sent to the security office in the Administration Building.
Is that open now?
It closes at five, so you've got about ten minutes.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply the man should do?
options: Come back to the classroom tomorrow
Wait until the next class ends
Go to the security office right away
questions.explain: 只剩約十分鐘就關門，暗示要立刻去警衛室，故選 (C)。(A)(B) 失物已送走，留在教室等沒有用。

audio.t: Thanks for coming to this orientation for new teaching assistants. Your main jobs are grading homework and leading the weekly discussion session. You are not expected to write exams. The professors do that. If a student complains about a grade, listen first, and then pass the complaint on to the professor.

questions.prompt: What is NOT one of the teaching assistants' duties?
questions.explain: 說話者明說助教不用出考題，由教授負責，故選 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 都是談話提到的助教工作。

audio.t: Are you still thinking of applying for the exchange program in Korea?
I'd like to, but my parents are worried about what it would cost. I'm checking whether the scholarship covers the flight.
You should talk to Ms. Liu in the international office. She helped my roommate last year.

questions.prompt: Why has the man not decided yet?
options: His roommate has already been accepted.
Ms. Liu advised him against it.
His family is concerned about the cost.
questions.explain: 男子說父母擔心費用，故選 (D)。(A) 室友是女子的室友，且只是受過協助；(B) 劉女士是女子建議去找的人，還沒談過；(C) 未提語言問題。

audio.t: Thank you for calling the university Language Center. Placement tests for spring courses will be held on December fifth and December twelfth. To register for a test, please visit our website. For questions about refunds, press two. To speak to a staff member, please stay on the line.

questions.prompt: What should a caller do to sign up for a placement test?
questions.explain: 語音說報名測驗要上網站，故選 (A)。(B) 按二是退費問題；(C) 不掛斷是找專人，並非報名管道。

audio.t: Good evening, everyone. I'm Alan Tsai, and I coordinate the peer tutoring program here at the Learning Center.

We're looking for second-, third-, and fourth-year students to tutor first-year students in math, chemistry, and English writing. You need a grade of B plus or higher in the subject you want to teach, and one recommendation from an instructor.

Tutors work three to six hours a week and earn one hundred eighty dollars an hour. Besides the pay, many past tutors told us the experience helped them in job interviews, because they could give real examples of leadership and communication.
All new tutors must attend a training workshop on the weekend of February twentieth. If you cannot make that date, I'm sorry, but you'll have to wait until the fall.
Applications are due on January twentieth. You can download the form from our website and hand it in at the Learning Center, on the second floor of Hall B.

questions.prompt: Who is this talk mainly for?
options: First-year students who need help with math
Students interested in working as tutors
questions.explain: 整段在招募同儕家教並說明條件與報名方式，對象是想當家教的學生，故選 (C)。(A) 大一生是被輔導的對象；(B) 老師只需寫推薦；(D) 面試只是舉例。

questions.prompt: What are the requirements for applying? (Choose TWO.)
options: A grade of B plus or higher in the subject
questions.explain: 談話明說需要該科 B+ 以上，以及一封老師推薦，故選 (B)(D)。(A) 招募的是大二以上；(C) 未要求教學經驗；(E) 面試是指日後求職，不是申請條件。

questions.prompt: What will happen to an applicant who cannot attend the February workshop?
options: They must wait until the fall.
They can attend a make-up session in March.
questions.explain: 無法參加就只能等到秋季，故選 (A)。(B)(C) 談話沒有提供替代方案；(D) 未提到減薪。

audio.t: Come in, Hsin-yi. You wanted to talk about adding a second major?
Yes. I'm majoring in business, but I got really interested in data science after taking an elective last term.
That's a popular combination. But the data science department requires thirty-six credits, and you're already a junior. Realistically, you'd need an extra year to finish both.
An extra year? I can't afford that. Is there another option?

You could do a minor instead. It's only eighteen credits, and six of them can come from courses you've already taken, including that elective. You could finish by graduation if you take a course or two each semester and one during the summer.
That sounds much more realistic. How do I apply?
Fill in the form at the department office before the end of this month. You'll need your transcript, and the department chair has to sign it.

questions.prompt: What is the main problem with the woman's original plan?
options: The business department does not allow it.
Her grades are not high enough.
The data science courses are already full.
questions.explain: 顧問說雙主修要多讀一年，故選 (D)。(A)(B)(C) 對話都沒有提到；限制在於學分數與時間。

questions.prompt: What does the adviser suggest?
options: Changing her major to data science
Taking data science as a minor
questions.explain: 顧問建議改修輔系（a minor），只要十八學分，故選 (B)。(A) 她是想增加而非更換主修；(C) 那門選修反而可以抵學分；(D) 沒有提到研究所。

questions.prompt: What does the woman need in order to apply? (Choose TWO.)
options: A letter from her elective teacher
An exam score from the business department
questions.explain: 顧問說需要成績單（transcript），且系主任要簽名，故選 (A)(C)。(B) 選修老師只是干擾；(D)(E) 都未提及。

audio.t: Welcome back to Campus Beat. Have you ever thrown away a broken fan or a laptop charger because fixing it seemed too expensive? A new student group called Fix-It Friday wants to change that.

On the first Friday of every month, engineering students set up tables in the Student Activity Center and repair small electronics, bicycles, and even clothes. The work is free. You pay only for any new parts.

Since opening in September, the group has received more than three hundred items, and about seventy percent of them work again. But members say the biggest reward isn't saving people money. It's teaching. Visitors are asked to stay and watch, so they can learn to do simple repairs themselves.
The group hopes to open a second location on the south campus next year, but first it needs more volunteers, especially people who can sew. If you're interested, stop by their next event.

questions.prompt: What service does Fix-It Friday provide?
options: It collects broken machines for recycling.
It repairs items without charging for the work.
It gives repair classes only to engineering majors.
questions.explain: 廣播說維修免費，只需付零件費，故選 (C)。(A)(B) 沒有買賣或回收；(D) 維修者是工程系學生，但服務與學習開放給來訪者。

questions.prompt: According to the report, what do the members value most?
questions.explain: 報導說最大的回報不是省錢，而是教學（It's teaching），故選 (B)。(A) 正是被否定的選項；(C)(D) 未提及。

questions.prompt: What does the group need before it can expand?
questions.explain: 廣播說要開第二據點，得先有更多志工，尤其會縫紉的人，故選 (D)。(A)(B)(C) 都沒有提到。

audio.t: Today I'd like to talk about urban heat islands, which is the name for city areas that are clearly warmer than the countryside around them. On a summer evening, a city center can be up to five degrees warmer than nearby farmland.
There are two main causes. First, concrete and asphalt absorb the sun's heat during the day and release it slowly at night. Second, cities have few plants, and plants normally cool the air.

Our own campus gives a good example. Last year, students in this course measured the temperature in two places: the parking lot behind the gym and the tree-covered square beside the library. At three p.m., the parking lot was four degrees hotter.
That is why the university plans to plant more trees and put a green roof on the new dormitory. Remember, a green roof isn't just decoration. The plants shade the building and cool the air around it.
For next week, please read chapter nine, and measure the temperature at one place of your choice.

questions.prompt: What is the lecture mainly about?
options: Why cities become warmer than surrounding areas
How to grow vegetables on a roof
How to read a weather report
questions.explain: 整場講都市熱島現象及成因，故選 (A)。(B) 綠屋頂只是對策之一，也沒提種菜；(C)(D) 未討論。

questions.prompt: Which causes of the problem does the speaker mention? (Choose TWO.)
questions.explain: 講者列出的兩個原因：混凝土與柏油吸熱、城市植物少，故選 (C)(E)。(A)(B)(D) 雖然聽起來合理，但講者沒有提到。

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker mention the parking lot and the square?
options: To explain where students may park
To give local evidence of a temperature difference
To compare the gym with the library
questions.explain: 用校內兩地實測相差四度來舉例說明熱島，故選 (B)。(A) 與停車規定無關；(C) 工程是後面才談；(D) 體育館與圖書館只是地點參考。

questions.prompt: The university will ______ tuition by three percent next year, so many students are worried.
questions.explain: raise 是及物動詞「提高」，後接受詞 tuition，故選 (A)。(B) rise 與 (C) arise 為不及物，不能接受詞；(D) arouse 是「引起（情緒）」。

questions.prompt: Students must ______ their ID card when they borrow equipment from the gym.
questions.explain: present 有「出示」之意，故選 (B)。(A) 防止、(C) 假裝、(D) 保存，字形相近但語意不合。

questions.prompt: The new dormitory has a ______ of 800 students, twice the size of the old one.
questions.explain: capacity 指「容納量」，故選 (D)。(A) 能力、(B) 設施、(C) 品質，都不能接學生人數表示容量。

questions.prompt: Applicants who do not ______ the minimum GPA requirement will not be considered.
questions.explain: meet a requirement 是固定搭配「符合要求」，故選 (B)。(A) 出席、(C) 加入、(D) 填滿都不與 requirement 搭配。

questions.prompt: The committee will ______ the proposal next week and announce its decision on Friday.
questions.explain: review 是「審查」，符合先審查再公布決定，故選 (A)。(B) 提醒須接人；(C) 反映／反思；(D) 移除，都不合語意。

questions.prompt: Because the two courses ______ on Monday mornings, I can't take both of them.
questions.explain: overlap 指「時間重疊」，故選 (C)。(A) 推翻、(B) 克服、(D) 忽略／俯瞰，都不合語境。

questions.prompt: The speaker's argument was supported by ______ from several recent studies.
questions.explain: evidence 是「證據」，研究提供證據支持論點，故選 (D)。(A) 意外、(B) 事件、(C) 住所，只是字尾相近。

questions.prompt: Students are ______ to return library books on time, or they will have to pay a fine.
questions.explain: be expected to 表「被期待／應該」，故選 (A)。(B) 被排除、(C) 花費、(D) 暴露，字形相近但語意不合。

questions.prompt: After weeks of ______, the two clubs agreed to share the rehearsal room.
questions.explain: 兩個社團達成協議前的過程是 negotiation（協商），故選 (B)。(A) 競爭與達成協議方向相反；(C) 裝飾、(D) 畢業與語境無關。

questions.prompt: Your research paper should begin with a brief ______ of the main findings.
questions.explain: 論文開頭放主要發現的 summary（摘要），故選 (C)。(A) 樣本、(B) 符號、(D) 高峰會，都不合語意。

questions.prompt: This scholarship is ______ to students from low-income families; others cannot apply.
questions.explain: be restricted to 表「僅限於」，後句說其他人不能申請，故選 (D)。(A) 拒絕、(B) 尊敬、(C) 反射都不合語意。

questions.prompt: Interns must keep the company's data ______ and may not share it with anyone outside.
questions.explain: confidential 是「機密的」，與不可外流呼應，故選 (C)。(A) 有條件的、(B) 傳統的、(D) 相當大的，都不合語境。

reading.title: Cedar Hall Laundry Room Notice
passage: Starting November 20, all washing machines and dryers in Cedar Hall will accept payment only through the CampusPay app. Coin slots will be removed. One wash costs NT$25 and one dry costs NT$15.
Residents without a smartphone may buy a prepaid laundry card at the front desk (minimum NT$100).
Please remove your clothes within 15 minutes after a cycle ends. Items left longer may be moved to the shelf beside the door. The dormitory is not responsible for missing items.

questions.prompt: What change will take place on November 20?
options: The laundry room will be moved.
Coins will no longer be accepted.
questions.explain: 公告說只收 CampusPay，投幣孔會拆除，故選 (D)。(A)(C) 機器與地點都沒有變動；(B) 只列出費用，並未說漲價。

questions.prompt: How can a student without a smartphone pay for laundry?
options: By paying cash to the machine
By buying a prepaid card at the front desk
By borrowing a friend's student ID
By asking staff to start the machine
questions.explain: 沒有手機的人可在櫃台買儲值洗衣卡，故選 (B)。(A) 投幣將取消；(C)(D) 公告未提到。

reading.title: Make-up Class
head: From: Prof. Hsu
To: ECON 201 students
Subject: No class on November 18
passage: Dear class, because I will be attending a conference in Singapore next week, our regular class on Wednesday, November 18 is cancelled. To stay on schedule, I would like to arrange a make-up session. There are two options.
Option 1: A live class on Saturday, November 21, from 10:00 to 12:00 in Room 405. Option 2: A recorded lecture, available online by November 20, with a short quiz due on November 24.
Please vote on the course website by this Friday. I will go with whichever option receives more votes. The date of the midterm (December 2) will not change.

questions.prompt: Why will the November 18 class not be held?
options: The professor will be away at a conference.
The classroom will be under repair.
Students will be taking the midterm.
questions.explain: 教授要去新加坡開會，所以停課，故選 (A)。(B)(D) 信中未提到；(C) 期中考是 12 月 2 日。

questions.prompt: What are students asked to do by Friday?
questions.explain: 信中請學生週五前在課程網站投票，故選 (C)。(A)(B) 是選項二的內容，且期限不同；(D) 是選項一的上課教室。

reading.title: Text Messages
passage: Amy (3:12 p.m.): Hey, are we still meeting at 6 to finish the poster?
Ben (3:14 p.m.): Yes, but Room 210 is taken. The booking system says there's a seminar.
Amy (3:15 p.m.): Ugh. How about the cafe on the first floor?
Ben (3:15 p.m.): Too noisy, and no table is big enough for the poster. The lounge on the 4th floor is free.
Amy (3:17 p.m.): OK. I'll bring the markers. Could you pick up the printed photos at the copy shop? I've already paid.
Ben (3:18 p.m.): Sure. It closes at 5:30, so I'll go right after class.

questions.prompt: Where will Amy and Ben most likely meet?

reading.title: The Cafeteria That Stopped Using Trays
passage: Last September, the main cafeteria at Hsin-Ming University quietly removed its trays. Students who were used to loading up with several plates suddenly had to carry what they could in two hands. At first, many complained on social media, calling the change annoying and a cost-cutting trick.

Six months later, the numbers tell a different story. Manager Wang Li-hua says that the food thrown away per student has fallen by 24 percent, and the cafeteria uses about 15 percent less water because no trays need washing. "When you can't pile everything up, you take only what you really want, and you come back if you're still hungry," Wang explains.

Not everyone benefits equally. Students with disabilities and those carrying heavy bags found the new system difficult. After a meeting with the Student Union, the cafeteria agreed to keep a small stack of trays at the counter, available to anyone who asks.

Encouraged by the results, the university now plans to go further. From next semester, the cafeteria will offer half-size portions at a lower price, and leftover cooked vegetables will be turned into compost for campus gardens instead of being sent to a landfill. A student survey in June will show whether people are happy with the changes.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why students prefer restaurants off campus
A cafeteria change that reduced waste despite early complaints
How cafeteria trays are washed and reused
How the Student Union took control of a cafeteria
questions.explain: 全文談拿掉托盤後，起初抱怨但成效良好，故選 (B)。(A) 未提校外餐廳；(C) 洗托盤只是細節；(D) 學生會只是協商，並未接管。

questions.prompt: Besides less food waste, what benefit does the article mention?
questions.explain: 第二段說少洗托盤後用水減少約 15%，故選 (C)。(A) 半份餐才便宜，且是下學期計畫；(B)(D) 文中未提。

questions.prompt: Why did the cafeteria keep some trays at the counter?

questions.explain: 第三段說身障或背重物的學生有困難，協商後保留少量托盤，故選 (D)。(A)(B)(C) 文中都沒有這些用途。

questions.prompt: What will the university do next semester?
options: Offer smaller meals at lower prices
Bring back trays for all students
questions.explain: 第四段說下學期推出較便宜的半份餐（half-size portions），故選 (A)。(B) 與主張相反；(C) 是把剩菜拿去做堆肥，不是賣菜；(D) 未提。

reading.title: What Losing a Startup Competition Taught Me
passage: When my friends and I entered the National Student Startup Challenge last spring, we were sure we would win. Our idea was an app called SeatFinder, which shows which library seats are free in real time. We had spent two months building it, and everyone we talked to on campus said they would use it.

We made it to the final round, but the judges' questions destroyed us. "How will you make money?" one asked. "Who pays for the sensors?" asked another. We had focused so much on the technology that we had never prepared a budget. We finished ninth out of ten teams.

I was embarrassed for weeks. Then Ms. Kuo, a mentor at the university's Innovation Center, told me something I have not forgotten: "The judges didn't reject your idea. They rejected your homework." She encouraged us to talk to the people who would actually pay: library managers.

Those conversations changed everything. We learned that libraries cared less about helping students find seats than about knowing which areas were used most. We rebuilt SeatFinder as a tool that gives libraries usage reports, and this fall two university libraries are testing it. We still don't know whether it will succeed as a business, but I now ask "Who will pay?" before "What can we build?"

questions.prompt: Why did the team do poorly in the final round?
options: Their app did not work during the demonstration.
Students said they would not use the app.
They had not prepared a financial plan.
They arrived too late to present.
questions.explain: 第二段說他們太專注技術，從沒準備預算，答不出如何賺錢，故選 (C)。(A)(D) 未提到；(B) 校園同學其實都說會用。

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Kuo mean by "They rejected your homework"?
options: The team had not done enough preparation.
The team had copied someone else's work.
The judges disliked the basic idea.
The team should focus on their class assignments.
questions.explain: 「不是否定點子，而是否定功課」意指準備不足，故選 (A)。(C) 正是她否認的；(B)(D) 把 homework 看成字面上的作業或抄襲，是字面干擾。

questions.prompt: What did the team learn from the library managers?
options: Libraries planned to remove many seats.
Libraries wanted data on how their spaces are used.
Libraries already owned a similar app.
questions.explain: 第四段說圖書館更在意哪些區域使用率最高，因此改做使用報告工具，故選 (B)。(A)(C)(D) 文中都沒有提到。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about SeatFinder now?
options: It already makes a large profit.
It has been sold to a university.
The team has given up on it.
It is still being tested, and its future is uncertain.
questions.explain: 兩所大學圖書館正在試用，作者也說還不知能否成功，故選 (D)。(A)(B) 無根據；(C) 團隊仍在持續開發。

passage: This winter, the Language Center will offer intensive courses from January 11 to February 5. The courses are open to all students and staff. Registration opens on December 1 on the Center's website and closes on December 18, or when a class is full (maximum 20 people). A course with fewer than 8 people will be cancelled, and fees will be fully refunded.
Current students receive a 20 percent discount on the fee shown in the table. Anyone who registers for two courses receives a further NT$500 off the total. Staff pay the full fee.

Intermediate and upper-intermediate courses require a placement test, unless you have completed a lower-level course at the Center in the past year. The test will be given on December 8 in Room L310. Those who withdraw before the first class get back 80 percent of the fee; no refund is given after classes begin.
